notes: Written from the guide's 'Game plan by turn' and 'Playbook seeds'. No written deck guide exists for this Leader (no top-8 result yet): every claim is our reasoning from card text [CARD-18], so the guide is confidence low and the mulligan rule is labelled our reasoning, not sourced.

Every number here is an inference: the guide gives the direction, not the value. weights, faceBias, counterAggression, cardValue and bias sizes were set by reasoning and have not been tuned on their own.

Bias sizes were chosen so the planted game-plan tests pass; ai/test/game-plan-g4.test.ts runs every seed with the biases off too, and lists the seeds that pass only because a bias encodes the guide's line.
Citations ('cite', 'citeSource') are what 'Why?' shows when a move follows the line; only biases whose condition is public carry one.
goFirst false: strategy-concepts section 10 [S17], the general default is to go second; the Leader's +1000 defends on the opponent's turn and its DON!! -2 is a tempo loan.
weights.don 1.1: the Leader returns 2 DON!! and sets 2 active, and Sanji & Pudding refunds one; DON!! on the field count a little more.
counterAggression 1.05, faceBias 0.95/1.0/1.05: a Straw Hat Crew midrange deck whose Leader defends (inference).
mulligan: our reasoning (no SH- tag): a searcher, and a couple of Counter cards; going second one piece short is fine, going first the searcher is required.
seed 3 uses the playBeforeActivate bias: Sanji & Pudding must already be on the field when the Leader's DON!! -2 returns two DON!!, or its refund does not happen.

assertions.text: Uses the Leader's DON!! -2 on every own turn from T2 on which it is legal.
Plays a Nami searcher (EB02-017 or PRB02-012) on T1 or T2 when one is in hand.
When it holds Sanji & Pudding and can pay for it, plays it before using the Leader's DON!! -2 on that turn.
